name: Can I finance an ADU construction project?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance an ADU construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are several financing options available for ADU construction. These often include construction loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), cash-out refinances, or personal loans. Some government-backed programs may also be available. The best option for you depends on your financial situation, existing equity, and the project's scope. We recommend consulting with a financial advisor and your bank to explore the most suitable financing solution for your ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU construction can be financed through options like construction loans, HELOCs, or cash-out refinances. Consult a financial advisor for the best fit.
